entries.source: The staff suggested a great deal about its parent culture. Artificed with as much attention to physical as metaphysical properties, its obsidian-like point had been honed to razor sharpness, giving the bearer a formidable weapon which could be used to stab as well as to focus spells.�
entries.translation: 這根法杖透露出許多關於其文化淵源的線索。工藝上兼顧了實用與玄奧兩個層面，黑曜岩般的杖尖被磨得鋒利如刃，讓持有者既能用它刺擊，也能用它聚焦法術，是件威力不凡的武器。�

entries.source: Made of light birch, the staff would be easy to swing should the need arise; doubtless it had been put to magical uses as well. Several lightning sigils were burned along its wavering length, the points of their bolts originating from a small crystal globe affixed to the knobby head of the staff.�
entries.translation: 這根法杖以輕巧的樺木製成，必要時揮動起來相當順手，顯然也曾被用於施法。杖身蜿蜒的表面燒刻著幾道閃電符文，符文的箭頭都指向杖首那顆嵌著的小水晶球。�

entries.source: While his woodworking skills wouldn't give his rivals reason to quit their professions, the crafter's staffsmanship was exceptional. From the bole of a yew tree, he had fashioned a staff which looked as if it could be used magically as well as a fighting weapon.�
entries.translation: 這位工匠的木工手藝雖稱不上讓同行望塵莫及，但製杖的功夫卻十分出眾。他用一段紫杉樹幹削製出這根法杖，看起來既能用於施法，也能當作戰鬥武器。�

entries.source: The stave's appearance was deceptive. On first glance it appeared to have more in common with a simple walking stick than a staff of power, but its exceptional balance would make it a superior fighting stick. Whoever had made it had purposely concealed its magical properties.�
entries.translation: 這根杖的外觀頗有迷惑性。乍看之下，比起法力之杖，它更像一根樸素的手杖，但異常出色的平衡感，讓它成為一根上乘的戰鬥用杖。製作者顯然是刻意掩藏了它的法術特性。�

entries.source: @ looked at the medallion skeptically. In Krondor similar amulets were sold as fool's trinkets, ornaments that seemed in all respects like true gold but were clever fakes run up by unscrupulous magicians. Checking the reverse side, he noted an inscription to Banath, the god of luck and of óthieves.�
entries.translation: @半信半疑地打量著這枚勳章。在克朗多，這類護身符常被當成騙人的小玩意兒兜售——外表看起來與真金無異，其實是無良法師巧手做出的贗品。翻到背面查看，他注意到上頭刻著獻給巴納斯神——ó幸運與盜賊之神——的銘文。�

entries.source: On many occasions @ had seen similar rings used by visiting magicians to cast spells to lighten darkened rooms. While he couldn't be certain by appearances alone the ring he held was of the same purpose, the reference to the god of light and fire in its name seemed a good indicator.�
entries.translation: @曾多次見過來訪的法師用類似的戒指施法照亮陰暗的房間。雖然光憑外觀無法確定手上這枚戒指是否也是同樣用途，但它的名字提到了光與火之神，這算是個不錯的線索。�

entries.source: A relatively simple device, the spyglass was a cylinder of brass fitted with a large glass lens on one end and another, smaller lens on the opposite end. While spyglasses were used to spot distant objects, @ suspected this one had been rendered useless by the cracks in the larger lens.�
entries.translation: 這是個構造相對簡單的儀器——望遠鏡是一根黃銅圓筒，一端裝著較大的玻璃鏡片，另一端則是較小的鏡片。望遠鏡本該用來觀察遠處的景物，但@懷疑這一支因為大鏡片上的裂痕，已經派不上用場了。�

entries.source: Tarnished, dented, peeling; while age had left its marks on the ancient ceremonial cup it had not diminished the majesty of the artisan's work. Four leprous serpents reared from the sides of the battered chalice, their eyes of ruby seething with mysterious intent.�
entries.translation: 鏽蝕、凹陷、剝落——歲月在這只古老的禮儀酒杯上留下了痕跡，卻絲毫沒有減損工匠手藝的莊嚴氣度。四條斑駁如癬的蛇形浮雕從這只破舊酒杯的杯身昂然而起，紅寶石鑲成的雙眼閃爍著神祕難測的意圖。�

entries.source: Slightly larger than the balled fist of a grown man, the hunk of reddish chalcedony was free of marks except for the obvious letter inscribed on its smooth face. In legend such stones were said to possess the power to summon a rusalki lover, though @ gave little credence to the claim.�
entries.translation: 這塊紅玉髓比成年男子的拳頭略大，光滑的表面除了刻著一個明顯的字母，並無其他痕跡。傳說中，這種石頭擁有召喚露莎奇情人的力量，不過@對這種說法不怎麼相信。�

entries.source: Although glory hands were greatly coveted by witches of various ilks, @ wished only to put the horrid thing down. He poked at the mummified form. Bits of yellowed bone showed through cracks in the blackened flesh, the only certain sign the hand had once belonged to a human.�
entries.translation: 雖然各路女巫都對「榮耀之手」趨之若鶩，@卻只想趕快把這噁心的東西放下。他戳了戳這具乾屍般的手掌，發黃的骨頭從焦黑的皮肉裂縫間露出來，是這隻手曾屬於人類的唯一確鑿證據。�

entries.source: Reinforced at the bell and mouthpiece with brass collars, @ struggled to imagine the beast from which the horn had been harvested. While possible it had come from a mature dragon, no man alive would dare fight such a creature for so trivial a trophy. Puzzling too were the dog shapes carved on the horn.�
entries.translation: 號角的喇叭口與吹嘴都用黃銅箍加固過，@實在難以想像這是從什麼野獸身上取下的。雖然有可能來自成年的龍，但沒有活人會為了這麼微不足道的戰利品，去挑戰這種生物。號角上雕刻的犬形圖案，也同樣令人費解。�

entries.source: The votive idol rested in his hand like a squat, sexless gnome. Rationally @ knew it would take no great effort to crush the leering ivory figurine; he would merely have to close his hand. But somehow he felt as if their roles were reversed, as if óhe were the fragile thing in the statuette's tiny palm.�
entries.translation: 這尊祈願神像躺在他掌心，像個矮胖、性別不明的地精。理智上@知道，捏碎這尊咧嘴而笑的象牙小雕像不費吹灰之力，只要握緊拳頭就行。但不知為何，他卻覺得彼此的角色顛倒了過來，彷彿ó他才是躺在雕像小小掌心裡那個脆弱的東西。�

entries.source: A pervasive feeling of malice radiated from the pendant. Within its depths bloody points of light pulsed, swarming from one side of the glass to the other as anything brushed against its featureless surface.�
entries.translation: 這枚墜飾散發出一股揮之不去的惡意。它的深處，血紅色的光點不斷搏動，只要有什麼東西碰觸到那毫無紋理的表面，光點便會從玻璃的一側湧向另一側。�

entries.source: As @ rattled the manna in his cupped hands, violent pulses of blue light flashed between individual shards and prickled his fingers. Though he had never encountered it in this form, he sensed the crystals were magical, perhaps manna, the very óessence of magic. It would still need to be converted into a form they could use.�
entries.translation: @把法力晶體捧在手心搖晃，一道道劇烈的藍光在碎片之間閃爍，刺得他的手指發麻。雖然他從未見過這種形態的法力，卻能感覺到這些晶體帶有魔力，或許正是法力本身——ó魔法的精髓。不過，這東西還得轉化成可用的形式才行。�

entries.source: Unable to identify the signet on the face of the ring, @ checked the inner surface for an inscription. Barely legible was a short epithet written for an unknown reader: ñI ñthink ñit ñworks, ñthis ñring ñof ñmine, ñbut ñit'll ñsneeze, ñ'bout ñhalf ñthe ñtime.�
entries.translation: @ñ我ñ想ñ這ñ戒ñ指ñ有ñ效ñ不ñ過ñ它ñ老ñ是ñ打ñ噴ñ嚏�

entries.source: There was something ñdifferent about the shell. Perhaps it was in the color or texture, but he was sure he had never seen another quite like it in all the trading meets he had ever attended. The oddest thing about it was a pattern of ten bumps on the inner lip of the shell.�
entries.translation: 這只貝殼有種ñ與眾不同之處。或許是顏色，或許是質地，但他確定自己在參加過的所有交易市集裡，從未見過相同的東西。最奇特的地方，是殼內邊緣上那十個突起排成的圖案。�

entries.source: If not for the regularity of its faceted surface the wyvern's egg could have passed as a peculiar geode, a quartzite anomaly created by the whims of nature. As @ touched it, however, there could be no doubt that something lived within its fragile shell.�
entries.translation: 要不是表面的刻面過於規則，這顆飛龍蛋簡直能被當成一顆奇特的晶洞，一種由大自然隨興造就的石英異象。然而@一碰到它，便毫無疑問地感覺到，這脆弱的殼裡有什麼東西活著。�

entries.source: Slicing air with the weapon, @ made a few passes at an imaginary foe. Although the sword was not the most remarkable he had ever held, it would serve well enough if he found himself in a sword battle.�
entries.translation: @揮舞著這把武器劃破空氣，朝著假想敵比劃了幾招。雖然這把劍算不上他持過最出色的一把，但若真陷入劍鬥，應該還能派上用場。�

entries.source: Holding up the double-edged, basket-hilted sword for inspection, @ favored it with a nod. The numerous sharp teeth that bristled along the edge of the weapon guaranteed a deep cut if the blade was swung properly.�
entries.translation: @舉起這把雙刃、籃式護手的劍仔細端詳，滿意地點了點頭。劍刃邊緣密布的鋸齒，只要揮砍得法，必定能造成深可見骨的傷口。�

entries.source: More than just a peasant's weapon, the goblin sticker was made to be wielded by hearty men accustomed to heavier blades. Numerous hammer marks were visible in the iron grade, evidence the weapon had likely been forged with only a few hours notice before a goblin raid over Kingdom borders.�
entries.translation: 這把「哥布林扦」不只是農民的武器，而是打造給習慣使用較重刀刃的壯漢揮舞。鐵料上滿是鎚打的痕跡，顯示這件武器很可能是在哥布林突襲王國邊境前，倉促幾個小時內趕製出來的。�

entries.source: Inspired by the lighter, laminated blades carried by the Tsurani during the Riftwar, the elven greatsword was a terror in battle. Double spurs jutted from the base of its flamberge-style blade and its haft had been fitted with a heavy pommel to allow it to be thrust like a rapier.�
entries.translation: 這把精靈巨劍靈感來自裂界之戰期間圖蘭尼人所持、較輕巧的疊層劍刃，是戰場上令人聞風喪膽的武器。火焰紋劍刃的根部伸出雙尖突起，劍柄則裝有沉重的劍首，讓它也能像細劍一樣用於刺擊。�

entries.source: Cautious at first and then with eagerness, @ wrapped his fingers around the hilt of the glamredhel sword and drew it hissing from its scabbard of flawless silver. On the blade, runes glimmered in lines of sundered flame, their meaning indecipherable to most but clear to any who held the blade: ñAVENGEð.�
entries.translation: 起初謹慎，隨即轉為急切，@的手指握住了格拉姆瑞德劍的劍柄，將它從無瑕的銀鞘中噝噝抽出。劍身上，符文如破碎的火焰般閃爍，對大多數人而言意義難解，但只要握住這把劍，便能讀懂：「ñ復仇ð」。�

entries.source: Set with brilliant stones of lapis and sapphire, the hilt was beautifully jeweled, but the sword blade had been long broken away. Still, as @ held it in his hand, he sensed it had the ópotential to be a deadly weapon...�
entries.translation: 劍柄鑲著璀璨的青金石與藍寶石，裝飾得美輪美奐，可惜劍身早已斷裂佚失。儘管如此，@握著它時，仍能感覺到它蘊藏著ó成為致命武器的潛力…�

entries.source: "Feels like something between a machete and a falchion," @ said, taking a few test swings with it. "A good slice with this weapon and you could take off a goblin's head."�
entries.translation: 「感覺介於彎刀跟砍刀之間，」@一邊試著揮了幾下，一邊說道。「用這武器好好劈一下，能砍下哥布林的腦袋。」�

entries.source: As a universal weapon the Moredhel Lamprey was poor. Imperfect balance wedded to the weapon's unwieldy weight made it classically difficult to control in close quarters and challenging for the shorter-limbed Kingdom soldiers to use.�
entries.translation: 作為一件通用武器，「莫瑞德七鰓鰻」的表現並不出色。平衡感不夠完美，加上笨重的份量，使它在近身格鬥中格外難以掌控，對四肢較短的王國士兵來說更是一大挑戰。�

entries.source: Within the Kingdom the rapier was considered the weapon of experts and fools. Smaller bladed than classical broadswords, it demanded a great deal of skill and concentration to use, its primary strategy depending on its sharpened point rather than on its hacking edge.�
entries.translation: 在王國境內，細劍被視為高手與傻子的武器。劍身比傳統闊劍細小，使用時需要極高的技巧與專注力，主要戰術仰賴劍尖而非刀刃的劈砍。�

entries.source: @ hefted the sword respectfully. In the hands of its dwarven makers it would doubtlessly have been considered a two-handed bastard sword, but even the most diminutive of human beings would have been hard pressed to get more than a hand and half over its spiral pommel.�
entries.translation: @恭敬地掂量著這把劍。在矮人工匠的手裡，這無疑會被視為一把雙手用的雜種劍，但即使是體型最嬌小的人類，握住那螺旋劍首時，也很難超過一手半的握距。�

entries.source: A shiver ran down @'s spine. Though the weight and play of the sword were as he expected, there was a darkness about the blade that unsettled him. No matter how he turned it, light órefused to reflect off its highly polished surface.�
entries.translation: 一陣寒意竄過@的背脊。雖然這把劍的重量與手感都在預料之中，但劍身透出的一股陰暗氣息，讓他心神不寧。無論怎麼轉動，光線都ó拒絕在那拋得光亮的劍面上反射。�

entries.source: Lacking the sharpened drooping quillons of the more basic Kingdom broadswords, the two handed variety had much to recommend itself. Heavier than a simple broadsword, the two handed variety was broader bladed and therefore more likely to hit and harm its intended target.�
entries.translation: 這把雙手劍沒有一般王國闊劍那種尖銳下垂的護手，卻自有其可取之處。它比普通闊劍更重，劍身也更寬，因此更容易命中並重創目標。�

entries.source: Disdain and approval warred within @ as he looked over the crossbow. On the surface he couldn't help but admire its sleek lines and sturdy construction; it would easily sling over his shoulder. But when blow came to blow he could hardly credit it as anything more than a hunter's toy.�
entries.translation: @端詳著這把弩，心裡輕蔑與讚賞交戰不休。表面上，他不禁讚嘆它線條流暢、做工紮實，背在肩上輕鬆稱手；但真要動起手來，他很難相信這東西比獵人的玩具強到哪去。�

entries.source: Experimentally @ snagged the bow back, grunted as it creaked violent complaint. It was a powerful crossbow, strong enough a bolt fired from it would likely puncture a common soldier's armor.�
entries.translation: @試著把弓拉開，弓身發出劇烈的抗議吱嘎聲，惹得他悶哼一聲。這是把威力強勁的弩，射出的箭矢很可能貫穿一般士兵的盔甲。�

entries.source: The crossbow type had become legendary since the end of the Riftwar. Replicated from a model discovered in the Northlands, the draw was impossible to set barehanded and required a lever called a goatsfoot be used to span its deadly draw. Fortunately, the crossbow had the device attached.�
entries.translation: 自裂界之戰結束以來，這款弩已成了傳奇武器。它仿製自北地發現的一把原型弩，弓弦強勁到光靠徒手根本拉不開，得用一種叫「山羊腳」的槓桿工具才能上弦。所幸，這把弩本身就附有這個裝置。�

entries.source: The heft of the crossbow alone was assuring, its potency seemingly worked into the very fiber of the weapon. Reputed to be more powerful than even the common Midkemian footsoldier's crossbow, they were rare treasures hoarded by weapons collectors.�
entries.translation: 光是掂量這把弩的份量，就讓人心生篤定，彷彿它的威力已經融入武器的每一絲纖維之中。據說它比一般米德凱米亞步兵用弩更加強勁，是武器收藏家爭相珍藏的稀世珍寶。�

entries.source: The ivory inlaid on the crossbow's darkly stained wooden tiller marked it as Tsurani, likely a weapon fashioned for the lord of a great house. It was also unusual in that the bow was made of a flexible material unlike anything found in the Kingdom.�
entries.translation: 弩身深色木製握把上鑲嵌的象牙，透露出這是圖蘭尼製品，很可能是為某個名門家主打造的武器。此外，弓臂所用的柔韌材質也十分特別，在王國境內找不到類似的東西。�

entries.source: Applying the same principles used on the famed elven longbows, the crossbow had a composite bow made of wood, bone, and sinew and the tiller was sheathed in parchment. If not elven himself, @ guessed the artisan of the crossbow had at least been in close contact with the archers of Elvandar.�
entries.translation: 這把弩運用了與著名精靈長弓相同的原理，弓臂以木材、骨頭與筋腱複合製成，握把則包覆著羊皮紙。@猜想，這把弩的工匠就算不是精靈本人，至少也曾與艾爾凡達的弓箭手有過密切往來。�

entries.source: Grabbing a quarrel at one end after the head and at the other end short of the flights, @ checked the give of the bolt by gently bending it in one direction and then the other. The spine of the arrow seemed good so it seemed ólikely there would be little quaver as the quarrel was in flight.�
entries.translation: @一手抓住箭頭後方，一手抓住箭羽前方，輕輕朝一個方向、再朝另一個方向彎折，測試箭桿的韌性。箭桿的硬度看起來不錯，飛行時應該ó不太會晃動。�

entries.source: @ smiled as he examined a single quarrel. Its shaft perfectly fletched and true, it would fly unerringly to its target, assuming of course his opponents would do him the courtesy of standing óstill.�
entries.translation: @端詳著一支箭矢，露出微笑。箭桿裝配得完美筆直，射出去必定不偏不倚，前提是他的對手肯ó乖乖站著別動。�

entries.source: The work of a wicked craftsman, the Tsurani quarrel was long, very nearly the length of a man's forearm and twice heavier than standardized Midkemian varieties. Twin barbs swept back from its laminate point and were meant to worry a victim's wounds, inducing bleeding and eventually death.�
entries.translation: 這支圖蘭尼箭矢出自一位陰狠工匠之手，長度幾乎等同成人的前臂，重量則是米德凱米亞標準箭矢的兩倍。疊層箭頭兩側伸出的倒鉤，就是為了在傷口裡反覆撕扯，導致大量出血、最終致命。�

entries.source: Poison gleamed on the quarrel's deadly head. Even should he only graze an opponent's shoulder with one of the bolts, the poison would have his victim writhing in pain within seconds.�
entries.translation: 箭矢致命的箭頭上，毒液閃著幽光。哪怕只是擦過對手的肩膀，這種毒也能讓中箭者在幾秒內痛苦扭動。�

entries.source: Poison gleamed on the quarrel's deadly head. Even should he only graze an opponent's shoulder with one of the bolts, the poison would have his victim writhing in pain within seconds.�
entries.translation: 箭矢致命的箭頭上，毒液閃著幽光。哪怕只是擦過對手的肩膀，這種毒也能讓中箭者在幾秒內痛苦扭動。�

entries.source: Poison gleamed on the quarrel's deadly head. Even should he only graze an opponent's shoulder with one of the bolts, the poison would have his victim writhing in pain within seconds.�
entries.translation: 箭矢致命的箭頭上，毒液閃著幽光。哪怕只是擦過對手的肩膀，這種毒也能讓中箭者在幾秒內痛苦扭動。�

entries.source: The quarrel was not meant to penetrate armor, but instead to set ablaze any cloth or fur the victim might be wearing. Affixed in the place of a tempered steel point was a small oilcloth bladder, fastened to the quarrel shaft by a leather cord. It's awkward shape would make it difficult to strike with.�
entries.translation: 這支箭矢的用途不是穿透盔甲，而是點燃目標身上的布料或毛皮。原本該裝淬火鋼箭頭的位置，換成了一個小小的油布囊，用皮繩綁在箭桿上。這種笨拙的形狀，讓它不容易命中目標。�

entries.source: Archers instantly knew it on sight. Flights misaligned on the shaft, head malformed, spine too rigid to allow level flight; it was a disgrace to any who crafted arrows. And yet the enchantment worked into the misshapen bolt by its sorcerous maker made it a peerless quarrel.�
entries.translation: 弓箭手一眼就能看出端倪：箭羽裝歪了、箭頭變形、箭桿硬得無法平穩飛行——對任何製箭匠而言都是丟臉的作品。然而，施法者賦予這支歪斜箭矢的附魔，卻讓它成了獨一無二的絕世箭矢。�

entries.source: It was simply the best armor ever made by human hands. An articulated breastplate with a sliding rivet arrangement, an interior quilted arming doublet to soften sharp impacts, slip catches beneath the arm gussets for quick suiting; the breastplate was a marvel both to wear and to look at.�
entries.translation: 這簡直是人類雙手打造過最頂尖的盔甲。胸甲關節處採用滑動鉚釘設計，內裡襯著厚實的棉甲以緩衝重擊，腋下的活動扣件則方便快速穿脫——無論穿在身上還是純粹觀賞，這副胸甲都堪稱一絕。�

entries.source: Commissioned by Earl Kasumi for his LaMutian soldiers, the design was an Tsurani improvement over Kingdom armor. Where rigid steel plates had been traditionally riveted, the armorcrafter Euliliko had used instead flexible lengths of horn which would allow the armor to fold without being punctured.�
entries.translation: 這副盔甲是卡澄美伯爵為麾下拉姆特士兵所訂製，設計上是圖蘭尼人對王國盔甲的一項改良。傳統上以鉚釘固定的堅硬鋼板，被鎧甲匠尤利利科換成了柔韌的長條獸角片，讓盔甲能夠彎折而不被刺穿。�

entries.source: Struggling with its complicated elven buckles, @ tried the breastplate on for size. Too wide for him at the shoulders, he was nonetheless pleased with its clever filigrees and fine fluted scrollwork, patterns designed to be decorative while also denying enemies a even striking plane.�
entries.translation: @費了一番功夫應付那些精靈式的複雜扣環，試穿了這副胸甲。雖然肩部對他來說太寬，但他仍對那精巧的鏤空花紋與精細的凹槽渦卷雕飾相當滿意——這些花紋既有裝飾效果，也能讓敵人的攻擊無法找到平整的受力點。�

entries.source: Even in its advanced state of deterioration, the dwarven armor was worth two suits of standard plate. Reddish brown scales of rust pocked its ancient surface, but its original making had rendered it so lifelike it appeared not like a corrupted metal breastplate but instead a cancerous human torso.�
entries.translation: 即使已經嚴重銹蝕，這副矮人盔甲仍抵得上兩套標準板甲的價值。紅棕色的鏽斑坑坑洞洞地爬滿古老的表面，但當初製作得極為逼真，讓它看起來不像一副鏽壞的金屬胸甲，反倒像一具長滿腫瘤的人類軀幹。�

entries.source: A thin shell of steel, the plate armor was ideally intended to be worn over a padded piece of clothing that they were regretfully without. But while the thin fabric of @'s tunic would be a poor substitute for a quilted gambeson, the armor itself would deflect far more sword blows than would bare skin.�
entries.translation: 這副板甲只是一層薄薄的鋼殼，理想上該搭配襯墊衣物穿著，可惜他們身邊沒有這種東西。雖然@身上單薄的束腰上衣拿來替代厚棉甲實在勉強，但這副盔甲本身，總比赤裸的皮膚能擋下更多劍擊。�

entries.source: Lustrous as no armor should be, it was unthinkable the suit had ever been in battle. Impossibly light, the breastplate was forged of a material that seemed like white gold but was harder than any steel @ had ever encountered.�
entries.translation: 這套盔甲光澤亮麗得不像一般護甲，簡直讓人難以想像它曾上過戰場。輕得不可思議，胸甲鍛造所用的材質看似白金，硬度卻超過@見過的任何鋼鐵。�

entries.source: The fluid within the flask was a clotted mass, tinged a phlegmy color that looked neither healthy nor appealing. And if the scent of the cork was anything similar to the actual aroma of the concoction within, he had no desire to open the bottle. Yet, if he were óattacked, it might be useful to distract an otherwise troublesome opponent.�
entries.translation: 瓶裡的液體凝結成一團，帶著痰液般的色澤，看起來既不健康也不誘人。要是瓶塞散發出的氣味跟裡頭這團東西的實際氣味相近，他根本不想打開這瓶子。不過，萬一ó遭到攻擊，這東西或許能用來分散麻煩對手的注意力。�

entries.source: @ untied the drawstrings which held closed the pouch and sifted through the ash colored material within. Buried underneath was a slip of parchment on which had been shakily printed, ñThrow ñinto ñface ñof ñvictim. ñLornus, ñArtificer ñof ñPalanque.�
entries.translation: @解開束緊袋口的繩子，翻找裡頭灰色的粉末。底下埋著一張寫著顫抖字跡的羊皮紙紙條：ñ朝ñ受ñ害ñ者ñ的ñ臉ñ丟ñ去ñ帕�

entries.source: @ struck the metallic device against his knee, cringing as it sang its high pitched note. "I always dread it when the jongleurs tune their instruments," he said, killing the still ringing note. "It's that ópitch. If my hearing were any more sensitive, I'd think I'd bleed from the ears ."�
entries.translation: @把這金屬器具敲在膝蓋上，隨即被那高亢的音調震得縮了一下。「我最怕看吟遊詩人調音了，」他一邊按住還在震動的音叉，一邊說道。「就是那ó音調。要是我的耳朵再敏感一點，恐怕真會被震出血來。」�

entries.source: Unminted, the golden coins were a wise choice for them to carry. Without the mark of a specific king or emperor, the coins would not raise problems with travelling traders who might otherwise be fearful of taking foreign currencies.�
entries.translation: 這些黃金沒有鑄成錢幣，是明智的攜帶方式。沒有特定君王或皇帝的印記，就不會讓那些擔心收受外國貨幣的行商起疑心。�

entries.source: Commanding less buying power coin for coin than golden sovereigns, the silver pieces would still be a welcome addition to their collective wealth. Granted their task was not to become rich, but the financial capacity to avoid starvation or death by exposure was uppermost in his thoughts.�
entries.translation: 銀幣一枚枚換算下來，購買力不及金幣，但仍是他們財富裡受歡迎的一部分。他們的任務固然不是發財，但至少要有足夠的錢財，才能避免挨餓受凍而死——這點始終盤據在他心頭。�

entries.source: @ grinned. While there were many Keshian thieves who would slit them from throat to belly to gain the brilliant full cut diamond, he expected there were just as many ladies of the court who would attempt much the same, though using weapons of a more persuasive kind.�
entries.translation: @咧嘴一笑。雖然不少凱許的竊賊會為了這顆璀璨的滿工切割鑽石，把人從喉嚨劃到肚子，但他猜想，宮廷裡想幹同樣事的貴婦恐怕也不少，只是她們用的武器更有說服力一些。�

entries.source: From what little he had learned from gems dealers at trading fairs, the emerald had been prepared in a ónavette cut. Beyond that, he wasn't certain what the actual value of the gem would be until he attempted to sell it.�
entries.translation: 從他在交易市集上跟寶石商學到的那點皮毛判斷，這顆祖母綠採用的是ó橄欖形切工。除此之外，這顆寶石的實際價值究竟多少，得等他試著賣掉才會知道。�

entries.source: Common as a pebble on a beach, the pear-cut ruby was used in the western Kingdom almost as frequently as golden sovereigns when traders were making large purchases. While their values were dependant on their quality, they almost never garnered more than four hundred sovereigns from a gems dealer.�
entries.translation: 這顆水滴形切割的紅寶石，普通得像海灘上的一顆卵石，在王國西部，商人進行大宗交易時幾乎跟金幣一樣常用。雖然價值因品質而異，但從寶石商那裡幾乎換不到超過四百枚金幣。�

entries.source: Shades of blue and alabaster chased one another round the surface of the spiral shell, winding tighter and tighter until the colors became an indistinguishable blur towards the center. While such shells were not entirely unique, they were sometimes collected and sold by poor peasants.�
entries.translation: 藍色與雪花石膏的色澤在這只螺旋貝殼表面上互相追逐，越捲越緊，到了中心處便融成一片難以分辨的模糊色塊。這種貝殼雖然算不上獨一無二，但偶爾會被貧苦的農民撿來收集販售。�

entries.source: By the look of it, the malachite and silver brooch had been meant to be a cloak fastener or a setting for part of a larger piece of jewelry. Crude by Kingdom standards, the moredhel brooch could still demand a reasonable price in the right shops.�
entries.translation: 看樣子，這枚孔雀石與銀製胸針原本是用來固定斗篷，或是某件更大首飾的一部分鑲座。以王國的標準來說做工略顯粗糙，但這枚莫瑞德胸針在對的店家，仍能賣到不錯的價錢。�

entries.source: @ could see the reason bartering for raw goods was beginning to disappear as the Kingdom of the Isles began to mint their own currency. Carrying around raw grain as a means to make purchases was far too ócumbersome.�
entries.translation: @看得出來，隨著島嶼王國開始鑄造自己的貨幣，以物易物的交易方式正逐漸式微。畢竟扛著一袋穀物到處採購，實在太ó麻煩了。�

entries.source: So small it seemed he could snap it between his fingers, the peasant's key was made of a tarnished copper, its color giving away its simple origin. The rough flashing that remained around the edges of the key further suggested the key had been only one of several hundred keys made.�
entries.translation: 這把「農民鑰匙」小到彷彿一捏就能折斷，以氧化發黑的銅製成，顏色透露出它出身平凡。鑰匙邊緣殘留的粗糙毛邊，更暗示它只是量產數百把裡的其中一把。�

entries.source: "This is a virtue key or I'm a gwali's uncle," @ said with a grin, tapping the dorsal shaped head. "Originally these keys were only made for chastity belts, but in the last hundred years or so they've expanded the use of the design. The locks this will open protect very valuable items."�
entries.translation: 「這是把『貞操鑰匙』，不然我就是隻大蜥蜴的舅舅，」@咧嘴一笑，敲了敲那背鰭狀的鑰匙頭。「這種鑰匙本來只用在貞操帶上，但過去這一百年左右，用途已經擴大了不少。能用它打開的鎖，裡頭鎖的東西通常都很值錢。」�

entries.source: Even an untrained artisan would be considered a fool if he failed to recognize the elven key of lineages. Three interlocked triangles formed the head of the long steel key, their matrix representing the ancient Midkemian tribes of the eledhel, the moredhel and the glamredhel.�
entries.translation: 就算是沒受過訓練的工匠，若認不出這把精靈「血脈之鑰」，也會被視為傻子。三個相互交疊的三角形構成這把長柄鋼鑰的鑰匙頭，代表著米德凱米亞古老的三大部族：光精靈、莫瑞德人與格拉姆瑞德人。�

entries.source: @ yelped as the tin key's serrated edge dug into the fleshy part of his palm. Angered, he held the key up for closer investigation. Evidently the key had been fashioned in a hurry, its edges left jagged and its face decorated only with a small wave shaped sigil. Whoever had made the key had not intended it for use on a daily basis.�
entries.translation: 這把錫鑰匙鋸齒狀的邊緣刺進手掌肉裡，痛得@叫出聲來。他惱火地把鑰匙舉起來細看。這把鑰匙顯然是倉促打造的，邊緣參差不齊，鑰匙面上只裝飾著一個小小的波浪形符號。不管是誰做的，顯然都不打算讓它日常使用。�

entries.source: Cast in brass, the key type was unfamiliar though it's size suggested it was made to open a door rather than a chest. On the reverse side was a royal seal, over which were inscribed three lines of script: Prop. of Nivek; Lrd. Mnst. of Fincs., Wstrn. Rlm; Krndr.�
entries.translation: 這種黃銅鑄造的鑰匙款式並不常見，但從尺寸看來，應該是用來開門而非開箱。背面刻著王家印記，印記上方有三行銘文：「產權屬尼維克；西域財政大臣；克朗多。」�

entries.source: A skeletal death's head grinned on the key's haft. "An interdictor key," @ said, tapping the key against the palm of his hand. "These keys are the ñonly way to open locks that have been blessed by the Death Goddess. I'm not sure I want to find the door this opens..."�
entries.translation: 鑰匙柄上，一顆骷髏死亡頭骨咧嘴而笑。「這是把『禁制鑰匙』，」@一邊說，一邊把鑰匙敲在掌心上。「要打開受死亡女神祝聖過的鎖，ñ唯有這種鑰匙才行。我還真不太想知道這能打開哪扇門…」�

entries.source: The gold key felt weighty in the palm of his hand, heavy with the noble arrogance that deemed such a flagrant display of wealth necessary. Known widely as the noble's passkey, the type was legendary for its tendency to snap off in locks at inconvenient moments.�
entries.translation: 這把金鑰匙握在掌心沉甸甸的，那份重量裡帶著一股貴族式的傲慢，彷彿如此張揚的財富展示才是必要的。這種俗稱「貴族通行鑰」的鑰匙素以「總在最不湊巧的時候卡斷在鎖裡」聞名。�

entries.source: @ wiped a bit of dirt off the key. Made from sterling silver, the guilder's passkey was a stunning piece of craftwork. It seemed profane such beautiful work was being wasted on simple tools.�
entries.translation: @擦掉鑰匙上的一點髒污。這把「公會通行鑰」以純銀打造，工藝美得驚人。這麼精美的手藝竟浪費在一件平凡的工具上，簡直有些褻瀆。�

entries.source: @ puzzled over the heavily lacquered wooden key. "I could be wrong, but I believe this is a Guildis Thorn," he said. "As I understand it, the dwarves were amused that the Tsurani traders used wood instead of metal to manufacture their goods and the dwarven name for the Tsurani keys stuck."�
entries.translation: @對著這把上了厚漆的木鑰匙百思不解。「我可能猜錯了，不過我認為這是把『基爾迪斯棘刺』，」他說。「據我所知，矮人覺得圖蘭尼商人用木頭而不是金屬做東西這件事很有意思，於是矮人替圖蘭尼鑰匙取的這個綽號，就這麼流傳了下來。」�

entries.source: Even without looking at the key, @ sensed something abnormal about it. "The key is...pulsing," he said. "The inscriptions on the haft have aspects about them that look elven, but parts also appear moredhel. Whatever it is, I have the feeling it predates the Kingdom, the Northlands or even Elvandar itself."�
entries.translation: 不用看，@光憑感覺就知道這把鑰匙不太對勁。「這把鑰匙…在搏動，」他說。「柄上的銘文，有些地方看起來像精靈文，有些又像莫瑞德文。不管是什麼，我覺得它的年代，恐怕比王國、北地、甚至艾爾凡達本身都還要古老。」�

entries.source: @ turned the tear-shaped key over. "The Prince of Krondor's standard," he said, indicating the bas-relief image of an eagle soaring high over a mountain's peak. "I could see why thieves might be interested in getting hold of a key that opens every door in the Prince's palace."�
entries.translation: @把這把淚滴形的鑰匙翻過來看。「這是克朗多王子的紋章，」他指著那浮雕——一隻雄鷹翱翔於山巔之上——說道。「難怪竊賊會對能打開王宮裡每一扇門的鑰匙這麼感興趣。」�

entries.source: Laying the brown parcel aside, @ carefully undid the short length of string that bound the package. Although standard rations ógenerally contained salted sweetmeats, hard rolls, sliced apples, and strawberry tarts, he was eager to get at whatever food was inside.�
entries.translation: @把這只棕色包裹放到一旁，小心解開綁著它的那截短繩。雖然標準口糧ó通常裝的是鹽漬蜜餞、硬麵包捲、蘋果片跟草莓塔，但他還是迫不及待想看看裡頭究竟是什麼吃的。�

entries.source: Laying the parcel aside, @ carefully undid the length of string that bound the package. Inside were an assortment of salted sweetmeats, hard rolls, sliced apples, and strawberry tarts, each portion individually wrapped and sealed with wax, though a few looked as if they might have been tampered with.�
entries.translation: @把包裹放到一旁，小心解開綁著它的細繩。裡頭是一份鹽漬蜜餞、硬麵包捲、蘋果片跟草莓塔的什錦組合，每一份都個別包好、以蠟封存，不過有幾份看起來像是被動過手腳。�

entries.source: Once, the rations might have been edible or even appetizing, but the stench that wafted from the opened parcel was more than enough to turn @'s stomach. It could not be eaten.�
entries.translation: 這份口糧或許曾經能吃、甚至可口，但包裹一打開，撲鼻而來的臭味已經足以讓@反胃。這東西沒法吃了。�

entries.source: @ flipped the armorer's hammer head over handle several times, catching it before it fell to the ground. As a weapon it would be entirely useless, its mass insufficient to cause injury, but it was an extremely handy tool to use to repair armor plates which were wedged loose during combat.�
entries.translation: @把這把鎧甲匠的鎚子拋了幾次，鎚頭轉了幾圈又接住，沒讓它掉到地上。當武器用完全沒用，重量不足以造成傷害，但拿來修補戰鬥中鬆脫的甲片，倒是件相當順手的工具。�

entries.source: Several times thicker than the variety made for standard crossbows, the heavy bowstring had been manufactured by winding several cords of spun hemp around a central material and looping the ends for easy fitting to a heavy crossbow.�
entries.translation: 這條重型弓弦比一般弩用的粗上好幾倍，是用幾股搓好的麻繩纏繞在一條核心材料外製成，兩端打了環扣，方便裝上重型弩。�

entries.source: Threading his thumbs through the ends of the silk bowstring, @ yanked as violently as possible to test the flexibility of the cord. While it seemed sturdy enough to handle the stress of repeated firings, he hoped it wouldn't disappoint him when he sighted down on an ill-intented opponent.�
entries.translation: @把兩根拇指穿進絲質弓弦的兩端，用盡力氣猛拉，測試這條弦的韌性。看起來夠堅韌，禁得起反覆發射的耐用度，但他還是希望，等他真正瞄準心懷不軌的對手時，這條弦別讓他失望。�

entries.source: A potent medicinal aroma wafted from the herbal pack as @ looked it over. Without opening it up, he was certain it contained the standard materials: alum and healer's alcohol. While it couldn't help regain lost strength, it would go a long way to increase the rate at which he healed.�
entries.translation: @端詳著這包藥草包，一股濃烈的藥味撲鼻而來。不用打開，他也確定裡頭裝的是標準藥材：明礬跟療者用酒精。雖然沒法幫他恢復失去的體力，但對加快傷勢痊癒的速度，卻大有幫助。�

entries.source: His curiosity sufficiently piqued, @ popped open the half-gallon cask and inhaled deeply. Immediately his senses reeled as the heady cinnamon-like aroma assaulted him. Keshian Ale!�
entries.translation: 好奇心被充分勾起，@打開這個半加侖的小酒桶，深深吸了一口氣。一股濃烈如肉桂的香氣立刻撲面而來，讓他頭暈目眩。凱許麥酒！�

entries.source: Reaching into the velvet pouch, @ withdrew a sterling silver lock picking tool. He studied it carefully, marvelling at the unmatched precision of its craftsmanship.�
entries.translation: @把手伸進絲絨小袋，取出一支純銀開鎖工具。他仔細端詳，讚嘆著這無與倫比的精密工藝。�

entries.source: In the hands of a ójongleur the lute was often a pleasure to him, but now that the instrument was in his hands, he wasn't certain it wasn't a deadly weapon. Even if he learned to master it, his repertoire of songs was frightfully limited.�
entries.translation: 在ó吟遊詩人手裡，魯特琴常是件賞心樂事，但如今這把琴到了他手上，他倒不敢肯定這不是件致命武器。就算學會了駕馭它，他能彈的曲目恐怕也少得可憐。�

entries.source: Disappointingly short, the length of hemp appeared to be sturdy enough to hold a man's weight should the need arise.�
entries.translation: 這段麻繩短得讓人失望，不過看起來夠堅韌，必要時應該撐得住一個成年人的重量。�

entries.source: It smelled awful. Covered with a strange green mold, the implement was rickety, its fractured length held together with an assortment of rusty nails. However it had been used recently, it had seen better times.�
entries.translation: 這東西臭得要命。表面覆著一層詭異的綠黴，構造搖搖晃晃，斷裂的部位靠著幾根生鏽的釘子勉強撐在一起。就算最近還被人用過，也早已是過了黃金歲月的東西。�

entries.source: He plucked at the torch's oil soaked wrappings. Although the rags were heavy with the scent of kerosene, he had no way to be certain how long the torch would last once lit.�
entries.translation: 他扯了扯火把上浸油的布條。雖然這些破布散發出濃濃的煤油味，但他無法確定一旦點燃，這把火把能燒多久。�

entries.source: @ ran his forefinger lightly across the rough grain of the whetstone. While it wouldn't last him long, it would be useful in keeping the edge of his sword from deteriorating.�
entries.translation: @用食指輕輕劃過磨刀石粗糙的紋理。雖然用不了多久，但至少能防止他的劍刃變鈍。�

entries.source: Uncorking the mouth of the oilskin, @ poured out a small portion of the gold flecked lacquer into his palm and examined it. Named after a type of impure brown glass common in Rillanon, it was an ideal resin to use on crossbow strings when they began to lose their cohesiveness.�
entries.translation: @拔開油皮袋的塞子，倒了一小份帶金色斑點的漆液到掌心細看。這東西以里蘭儂常見的一種不純褐色玻璃命名，是弩弦開始鬆散失去黏性時，用來塗抹的理想樹脂。�

entries.source: Turning over the coarsely woven cloth in his hands, he examined the blotches of yellow mold that seemed remarkably like a human face. It was probable the linen had been a burial shroud, the face imprinted upon it as the unknown man's flesh had dissolved into moldering corruption.�
entries.translation: 他把手裡這塊粗織布翻來覆去，端詳著上頭一團團黃黴斑，那模樣竟酷似一張人臉。這塊麻布很可能曾是件裹屍布，隨著這名無名男子的血肉腐爛消融，才把面容印上了布面。�

entries.source: The ring was a simple, unadorned band of gold which fit awkwardly on his finger. Worth only a small crafter's fee and the gold used in its forging, the ring was still charming in its own humble way. What mystified him was the peculiar way it warmed when someone ómoved near him.�
entries.translation: 這枚戒指是一圈樸素無華的金環，戴在他手指上有點不合。價值不過是一點工匠的手工費加上打造用的金子，但這枚戒指自有一股樸實的可愛之處。令他不解的是，每當有人ó靠近時，戒指便會以一種奇特的方式發熱。�

entries.source: Meant to be worn over the nose and mouth, the mask had been stitched together from a refuse heap assortment of dyed cloth, fish bone, wooden slats and discarded spinner's string.�
entries.translation: 這面面罩本是用來遮住口鼻，用一堆從垃圾堆撿來的染色布料、魚骨、木片跟廢棄紡線縫製而成。�

entries.source: The strange elven footwear was far too dainty to suit his tastes. Dyed bright green and trimmed with a thin cord of gold, they were obviously intended as something to be worn within boots or moccasins.�
entries.translation: 這雙精靈鞋履樣式古怪，精緻得完全不合他的口味。染成鮮綠色，邊緣鑲著一圈細金線，顯然是設計來穿在靴子或軟皮鞋裡的。�

entries.source: In ways the part resembled the gears used in crossbows, but where he associated the moving parts of hand-held weapons with precision, the catapult's axle gear was a ómonstrosityð, its tempered iron spokes radiating out from a flat circular plate thicker than ten swords stacked one atop another.�
entries.translation: 這零件某種程度上跟弩用的齒輪有幾分相似，但他印象裡手持武器的活動零件都該做得精細，這個投石機用的軸齒輪卻是個ó龐然怪物ð——淬火鐵條輻條般從一片扁圓板上向外輻射，那圓板的厚度，比十把劍疊在一起還要厚。�

entries.source: For a moment @ was beguiled by the patterns on the strange stones. Hues of red and ochre interlocked in an intricate web of fault lines and ridges, pooled together in shallow depressions; so complex were the shapes he could easily see why priests insisted they conveyed secret messages from the gods.�
entries.translation: 有那麼一瞬間，@被這些怪石上的紋路迷住了。紅色與赭色的色澤交織成一張錯綜複雜的斷層與稜脊之網，匯聚在淺淺的凹陷處；形狀複雜到讓他不難理解，為何祭司們堅稱這是諸神傳遞的祕密訊息。�

entries.source: The stamp was simple---the kind generally used by nobles or priests---and it had a handle made of ivory from which depended several silk streamers. The seal itself was of three pots stacked one atop another, the symbol associated with the powerful Glazer's Guild of Romney.�
entries.translation: 這枚印章樣式簡單——是貴族或祭司常用的那種——象牙製的握柄上垂著幾條絲帶。印面圖案是三只疊在一起的陶罐，正是羅姆尼那個勢力龐大的玻璃匠公會的標誌。�

entries.source: It seemed like a great deal of complexity to waste on an animal trap. Modeled on the trebuchets used by the Quegian army, it sported a counter-weighted fulcrum to which had been attached a barbed head; the whole mechanism triggered when an animal ate from a baited plate.�
entries.translation: 這麼複雜的機關用來做個獸夾，似乎有點大材小用。它仿照奎格軍隊使用的投石機設計，配有一個裝了倒鉤頭的配重支點；整套機關會在動物咬上誘餌托盤時觸發。�

entries.source: Someone had paid a great deal to have the chess piece made. The marbled soapstone from which it had been carved was of a type available only from a hellish region within Great Kesh known as the Jal-Pur Desert; an area also renowned for its óGedajiið, a Keshian brotherhood of thief assassins.�
entries.translation: 有人花了大錢請人打造這枚棋子。雕刻用的大理石紋皂石，只產自大凱許帝國境內一處地獄般的區域——賈爾普沙漠，那地方同時也以ó「格達吉」ð聞名——一個凱許境內的盜賊刺客兄弟會。�

entries.source: He fidgeted with the lecture ticket. Not wanting to inadvertently anger the god Ishap by breaking the divine seal set in blue wax on the ticket's face, he bent back a corner of the parchment ticket but was unable to read the finely printed text on the interior.�
entries.translation: 他把玩著這張講座票券，有些坐立不安。因為不想弄破票面上那圈藍蠟印的神聖封印，惹惱伊夏神，他只小心翼翼地把羊皮紙票券的一角折起來，卻看不清內側那些細密印刷的文字。�

entries.source: No matter how he re-laced them, the cured leather leggings wouldn't fit him. "Perhaps we can find someone to sell these to," @ said as he slid them off. "I certainly won't be able to wear them."�
entries.translation: 不管怎麼重新繫緊，這條硬化皮革護腿就是不合他的身。「或許我們能找人把這個賣掉，」@一邊脫下護腿一邊說。「反正我肯定是穿不了了。」�

entries.source: @ considered the rotted thing. Yellowed, encrusted with grave mold; one day his own hand would look the same, assuming someone didn't simply leave his corpse to be stripped of flesh by wild animals---and even then mold would form on his skeletal remains.�
entries.translation: @打量著這團腐爛的東西。發黃，結著一層墓地黴斑；有朝一日，他自己的手也會變成這副模樣，除非有人乾脆讓他的屍體被野獸啃食一空——即使如此，殘留的骨骸上遲早也會長出黴斑。�

entries.source: Made of a glazed metal, three concentric rings encircled the mushroom shaped device's base, through which was visible a globe of glass that flashed periodic bursts of white light. While the design was Tsurani, it could only have been made on Midkemia, the price of metals too prohibitive on Kelewan to allow such an extravagant device to be built.�
entries.translation: 這件裝置以上釉金屬製成，蕈狀底座外環繞著三圈同心環，透過環圈能看見一顆玻璃球，不時閃出一陣陣白光。雖然是圖蘭尼式設計，卻只可能是在米德凱米亞打造的——凱勒旺的金屬價格太過高昂，容不下這麼奢侈的裝置。�

entries.source: Roughly the size of a baked loaf of bread, the wooden chest seemed extraordinarily heavy, as if something made of solid lead was contained within, but there were no visible marks on the miniature chest to indicate what it had been crafted to hold...�
entries.translation: 這只木箱大約一條烤麵包的大小，卻重得出奇，彷彿裡頭裝著什麼實心鉛塊，但這只迷你箱子上看不出任何標記，無從得知它原本是打造來裝什麼的…�

entries.source: Frost encysted the crystalline point of the magician's tool, faint tendrils of mist trailing its arc as @ waved it back and forth. If not for the engraved words on its handle, he might not have guessed its purpose: ñFor ñmagical ñtreatment ñof ña ñblade. ñAlthafain ñthe ñartificer.�
entries.translation: 這件法師工具水晶般的尖端結了一層薄霜，@來回揮動時，細絲般的霧氣隨之飄散。要不是握柄上刻著幾個字，他恐怕猜不出這東西的用途：ñ為ñ劍ñ刃ñ施ñ加ñ法ñ術ñ處ñ理�

entries.source: Distributed once a year from the Temple of Tith, oilcloths were often resold by the poor to any who would buy. The oil which was soaked into the fiber had numerous qualities, though it was best known for its magical effects when smeared on edged weapons or on armor.�
entries.translation: 這種油布每年由提斯神殿發放一次，窮人常常轉手賣給任何願意收購的人。浸透布料纖維的油有多種用途，但最出名的還是塗抹在利刃或盔甲上時產生的法術效果。�

entries.source: Famed on Kelewan as a deadly slow poison, Coltari Poison would be of no use on a blade, its effects too delayed to be of any use against an armed opponent. It could, however, be applied to foods or drinks to strike down an unsuspecting victim.�
entries.translation: 「科塔利毒藥」在凱勒旺以致命的慢性毒藥聞名，用在刀刃上沒什麼作用，發作太慢，對付持械的對手起不了效果。不過，把它下在食物或飲料裡，倒是能悄悄放倒毫無防備的受害者。�

entries.source: As if some magic within the azure stone was awakened by @'s touch, a dark fluid began to spill through a crack in the artifact's mottled surface and down the length of his arm. Where droplets contacted cloth they shied, but touched to smooth metal, it infused itself and disappeared.�
entries.translation: 彷彿@的觸碰喚醒了這塊天青石裡的某種魔力，一道黑色液體開始從器物斑駁的表面裂縫中滲出，沿著他的手臂流下。液滴碰到布料時會彈開，但一碰上光滑的金屬，便會滲入其中消失不見。�

entries.source: Introduced to the Kingdom by Althafain after several soldiers had been injured by frost bladed weapons, the viscous oil could be bought as a protective coating for armor. Any frost bladed weapon that came into contact with the brown fluid would instantly return to normal temperature.�
entries.translation: 這種黏稠的油是阿爾薩芬在數名士兵被冰霜利刃所傷後，引進王國的，可以買來當作盔甲的防護塗層。任何冰霜利刃一接觸到這種棕色液體，便會立刻恢復常溫。�

entries.source: An emerald colored fluid rippled the length of the flute-necked bottle as @ upended it, then righted it once more. A very light oil, it was used by soldiers to temporarily enhance the metallic qualities of their swords and of their armor.�
entries.translation: @把這只細頸瓶倒過來又扶正，翠綠色的液體隨之在瓶身裡蕩漾。這是一種質地極輕的油，士兵用它來暫時強化劍與盔甲的金屬特性。�

entries.source: Unlabeled and unadorned, @ still recognized the large ceramic container for what it held. Naphtha. Applied to a sword blade in small amounts and set ablaze, it would exacerbate the pain of any cut made with the blade, though the oil would quickly burn off a sword once applied.�
entries.translation: 這只大陶罐沒有標籤，也沒有任何裝飾，但@仍認出了裡頭裝的是什麼——那夫沙油。少量塗在劍刃上並點燃，能讓劍傷的痛楚加劇，不過塗上之後，這種油很快就會從劍上燒盡。�

entries.source: A yellow colored ointment, the Sarig's Bane was stored in an odd-looking container; a simple cork cap suspended from the mouth of a glass tube, a large bulb made from stitched sheep gut. Commonly it was applied to armor to counteract the effects of enchanted blades.�
entries.translation: 「薩瑞格的剋星」是一種黃色藥膏，裝在一個造型古怪的容器裡：一根玻璃管口垂掛著簡單的軟木塞，連著一個以縫製羊腸做成的大氣囊。通常用來塗抹盔甲，抵銷附魔劍刃的效果。�

entries.source: With the exception of its carnelian tinged fangs, the miniature spider glinted a deadly silver hue. On its underbelly, a long shallow groove bisected its length and passed between its fangs; a groove through which a swordblade or an arrow point could be easily passed.�
entries.translation: 除了那對帶著紅玉髓色澤的獠牙，這隻迷你蜘蛛通體閃著致命的銀色光澤。牠的腹部有一道細長的淺溝貫穿全身、通往獠牙之間——劍刃或箭頭都能輕易從這道溝槽滑過。�

entries.source: @ was careful as he held it up, knowing a single scratch from its silvery thorns could kill. Corpulent red berries dangled from the plant's rose-like stem, each bud heavy with deadly poison. If crushed over a blade or an arrow, the Silverthorn would make any cut made with the weapon far more lethal.�
entries.translation: @小心翼翼地捧著它，深知只要被那銀色尖刺劃破一下皮膚就能致命。這株植物玫瑰般的莖上垂著飽滿的紅色漿果，每一顆都蘊藏著致命的毒液。把「銀刺」壓碎塗在劍刃或箭頭上，能讓武器造成的傷口致命得多。�

entries.source: Purple globes fanned out from a delicately spun central vein of glass, each small grape-like bulb containing enough anti-venom to neutralize a double amount of Silverthorn. Thanks to a formula created by Father Nathan of Krondor years previously, the antivenom had saved the lives of many who had smeared it on their armor before confronting moredhel raiders or consumed it to heal themselves of the effects of Silverthorn.�
entries.translation: 紫色的球狀物從一根精細紡製的玻璃莖脈向外展開，每顆葡萄般的小球裡都裝著足以中和雙倍劑量「銀刺」毒素的解毒劑。多虧了克朗多的納坦神父多年前研製出的配方，這種解毒劑救過不少人的性命——有人在迎戰莫瑞德襲擊者前塗在盔甲上，也有人服下它來治療「銀刺」中毒的症狀。�

entries.source: Hawked at fairs and trading meets by the Brotherhood of the Shield of Dala, Dalatail Milk was really nothing more than simple springwater, albeit springwater blessed by a priest of the defender goddess. It was reputed to increase one's ability to defend oneself during combat.�
entries.translation: 「達拉泰爾聖水」由達拉聖盾兄弟會在市集與交易會上兜售，其實不過是普通的泉水——只不過是經過守護女神祭司祝福的泉水。據說能增強戰鬥中自我防禦的能力。�

entries.source: Infamous by reputation, the notorious strength potion had on several occasions disrupted proceedings at lancer's tournaments. Expressly forbidden because of its unbalancing effects in combat, it still commanded high prices from soldiers looking to advance their positions with employing lords.�
entries.translation: 這種惡名昭彰的力量藥水曾好幾次擾亂長槍比武大會的進行。由於會破壞戰鬥中的平衡性而遭到明令禁止，但對想在雇主面前出人頭地的士兵來說，它依然能賣出高價。�

entries.source: On countless occasions, @ had observed magicians carrying vials of the same fluid, almost always downing the concoction before setting to work casting incantations. For a brief period of time the imbiber would seem intensely focused, ignorant of events outside his purpose.�
entries.translation: @曾無數次見過法師隨身攜帶同樣的藥液，幾乎總是在施法唸咒之前先一飲而盡。喝下之後短時間內，飲用者會顯得異常專注，對目的以外的事物渾然不覺。�

entries.source: @ shook the vial. Called Tith's Piss among mercenaries, the liquid was famed for its vile metallic flavor and ruddy color, both owing to the fact the liquid was gathered from the rusty drainpipes of the Temple of Tith. Many claimed the fluid could improve an imbiber's swordplay for a short time.�
entries.translation: @搖了搖這只小瓶。傭兵之間都稱它「提斯尿」，以那股惡劣的金屬味與紅銹色澤聞名——都是因為這液體是從提斯神殿生鏽的排水管收集來的。許多人聲稱喝下後能在短時間內提升劍術。�

entries.source: The tea was darkish grey-black. Brewed by the elves from roots unique to Elvandar, the concoction had a strong herbal aroma and was often sold as a highly priced spice, though @ valued more its fleeting tendency to sharpen sight, a quality which a archer friend had once demonstrated.�
entries.translation: 這種茶呈暗灰黑色，是精靈用艾爾凡達特有的根莖釀製而成，帶著濃烈的草本香氣，常被當作昂貴的香料出售，不過@更看重它短暫增強視力的效果——這一點，一位弓箭手朋友曾親自示範過。�

entries.source: A comforting warmth blanketed @ as he shook the vial of restorative fluid, its magical effects radiating up the length of his arm and then down through his limbs and torso. He would, of course, have to swallow the liquid to reap benefit of its healing powers.�
entries.translation: @搖動這瓶恢復藥液時，一股安慰人心的暖意籠罩了他，法力沿著手臂向上蔓延，再流竄過四肢與軀幹。當然，他還是得把液體喝下去，才能真正發揮其療癒的力量。�

entries.source: Not yet convinced he should take the time to read over the missive's contents, @ studied the yellowing parchment but found nothing particularly outstanding about the ink in which it was printed or the cut of the paper.�
entries.translation: 還沒能說服自己該花時間讀完這封信的內容，@端詳著這張泛黃的羊皮紙，卻看不出印刷的墨跡或紙張的裁切有什麼特別之處。�

entries.source: Its spine a patchwork of cracked hide and shiny leather, new pages sandwiched between ancient sheaves of parchment; the book had been repaired numerous times during its long history.�
entries.translation: 書脊由龜裂的獸皮與光亮的皮革拼補而成，嶄新的書頁夾在古老的羊皮紙頁之間；這本書漫長的歷史裡，顯然被修補過許多次。�

entries.source: Even with a cursory glance he could tell the book was rife with spelling errors, apparently much to the vexation of a previous reader. Large sections of the document had been struck through and rewritten in a more elegant hand in the margins of the book.�
entries.translation: 只消隨意一瞥，便看得出這本書錯字連篇，顯然讓某位先前的讀者頗為惱火。大段大段的文字被劃掉，改以更工整的字跡重新寫在書頁邊緣。�

entries.source: @ flipped through the crisp, well lettered pages with growing interest. Seeing a passage he thought might be of later interest when reading, he dog eared the edge of a page, but was astonished as the page óunbent óitself, the crease vanishing without a trace before his very eyes.�
entries.translation: @翻著這些筆跡工整、紙質挺括的書頁，興致越翻越濃。看到一段覺得日後可能有用的文字，他把書頁一角折了起來，卻驚訝地看見書頁自己ó展開ó復原，折痕在他眼前消失得無影無蹤。�

entries.source: As the book looked and smelled quite new, @ turned to the onion skin covered title page and discovered a dedication written there. ñThis ñis ña ñcopy ñof ña ñwork ñscribed ñin ñthe ñthird ñyear ñof ñthe ñreign ñof ñKing ñLyam ñthe ñFirst ñfor ñBrother ñFaushane, ñarcher ñand ñfriend.�
entries.translation: 這本書看起來、聞起來都相當新，@翻到蒙著洋蔥皮紙的扉頁，發現上頭寫著一段獻詞：ñ此ñ書ñ乃ñ萊ñ亞ñ姆ñ一ñ世ñ登ñ基ñ第ñ三ñ年ñ所ñ抄ñ錄ñ之ñ作ñ獻ñ給ñ摯ñ友ñ兼ñ弓ñ箭ñ手�

entries.source: The illuminations inside the book depicted a variety of scenes; a man blocking a sword thrust, the goddess Dala watching over men on the field of battle, mercenaries kneeling in front of the Temple of Dala near Highcastle. Overall, the text looked more like a religious tract than a manual on battle.�
entries.translation: 書中的插畫描繪了各式各樣的場景：一名男子擋下一記劍刺、達拉女神在戰場上守護著士兵、傭兵在高堡附近的達拉神殿前跪拜。整體看來，這本書的內容與其說是戰鬥手冊，更像一本宗教小冊。�

entries.source: Though the book had been bound in fine leather, it had been ill-treated in the time since it left the scribe's hands. Numerous parchment pages were dog-eared, others smeared with grease or oil, some pages were half torn, others were missing altogether; all hallmarks of a oft-used book.�
entries.translation: 雖然這本書以上等皮革裝訂，但自從離開抄寫員之手後，顯然沒有受到善待。許多羊皮紙頁角落都折了起來，有些沾著油漬，有些頁面撕去了一半，還有幾頁乾脆不見蹤影——全是一本被頻繁翻閱過的痕跡。�

entries.source: @ grunted, the volume a leaden weight in his hands. Considering the difficulty he had in getting through even the thinnest written works presented to him, he was astounded any writer would actually have the stamina to fill the thousand or more pages stitched between the book's leather covers.�
entries.translation: @悶哼一聲，這本書拿在手裡沉甸甸的，像塊鉛塊。想到自己連最薄的文字作品都讀得吃力，他不禁驚訝，居然有作者能有毅力寫滿這本皮革封面書裡上千頁的內容。�

entries.source: @ gaped in astonishment as he clawed through the bountiful mound of fruit; fresh blackberries, swollen with juice, nearly bursting; golden apples, still wet with morning dew; grapes piled high in alternating clumps of green and purple---nearly a banquet fit for royalty. A handful of it would certainly last him at least a day.�
entries.translation: @目瞪口呆地翻找著這堆豐盛的水果：新鮮的黑莓飽滿多汁，幾乎要脹裂；金黃色的蘋果還沾著清晨的露水；一串串葡萄堆得高高的，綠紫相間——簡直是一場堪比王室的盛宴。光是一把，就足夠他撐上至少一天。�

entries.source: Fermented in the vineyards of the Dauphiness of Queg, the brandy was classically smooth, lacking the bitterness of some of the vintages grown in the Kingdom.�
entries.translation: 這瓶白蘭地釀自奎格公主領地的葡萄園，口感經典醇厚，沒有王國境內某些年份酒常有的那股苦澀。�

entries.source: The contents of the cup were typical of the ale found in most of the Kingdom, a dark brown mixture with a seedy scum floating on the surface. All in all, not the best of drinks but one that could induce a mellower outlook when life grew too stressful.�
entries.translation: 杯裡裝的是王國各地常見的麥酒，深褐色的液體上飄著一層帶籽的浮渣。整體來說算不上上等飲品，但生活壓力太大時，喝了倒能讓人的心境緩和一些。�

entries.source: Leery of the cup offered him by the tavern maid, @ tipped the cup and sniffed its dark contents. Immediately his senses reeled as the heady cinnamon-like aroma assaulted him. Keshian Ale!�
entries.translation: @對酒館女侍遞來的這杯酒有些戒心，傾杯聞了聞裡頭深色的液體。一股濃烈如肉桂的香氣立刻撲面而來，讓他頭暈目眩。凱許麥酒！�

entries.source:
@ prayed that merely wearing the ring would be enough and focused his attention on a fixed point before him. In his mind he tried to imagine---to óseeð---how his surroundings would look when fully lit.
	Something within the ring responded...�
entries.translation:
@暗自祈禱，光是戴著這枚戒指就夠了，將注意力集中在眼前的一個定點上。他在腦海中試著想像——ó看見ð——四周被完全照亮後會是什麼模樣。
	戒指裡的某種東西，回應了…�

entries.source: Undaunted by the spyglass' cracked lenses, @ raised the nautical tool to his eye and looked through it. While visually he could see nothing, it was almost as if he saw something beyond the world before him. By some facility he was able to see objects that were óhidden from his view...�
entries.translation: 即使望遠鏡的鏡片有裂痕，@仍不氣餒，把這航海儀器舉到眼前望去。雖然視覺上什麼也看不見，卻彷彿窺見了眼前世界之外的什麼東西。憑藉某種能力，他竟能看見那些原本ó隱藏在視野之外的事物…�

entries.source:
@ shook as he lifted the jeweled cup, feeling power flare within the jeweled artifact. In ever expanding circles, his consciousness stretched outward, touched on the minds of those with whom he travelled, finding awe, confusion, fear, pain, óknowledgeð...
	With jarring suddenness Owyn's mind was joined to Pug's, each dazed by the intimacy of the contact. ñConcentrate ñon ñwhat ñyou ñknow ñof ñspellcraft, Pug thought. ñI ñshall ñdo ñthe ñsame, ñthough ñI ñstill ñbelieve ñI ñshall ñbenefit ñmore ñfrom ñthis ñthan ñyou. ñMost ñof ñwhat ñI ñremember ñof ñspellcasting ñis ñthat ñwhich ñyou ñhave ñgiven ñto ñme. ñIt ñis ñpossible ñI ñmay ñnever ñfully ñrecover ñwhat ñI ñknew ñbefore...�
entries.translation:
@顫抖著舉起這只鑲滿珠寶的酒杯，感覺力量在這件寶飾器物中迸發湧動。他的意識如漣漪般不斷向外擴散，觸及了同行者的心靈，感受到敬畏、困惑、恐懼、痛苦，還有ó知識ð…
	猛然之間，歐文的心靈與帕格的心靈連結在一起，兩人都被這份親密的接觸震得暈頭轉向。ñ專ñ心ñ回ñ想ñ你ñ所ñ知ñ的ñ法ñ術ñ吧ñ，ñ帕ñ格ñ心ñ想ñ。ñ我ñ也ñ會ñ這ñ樣ñ做ñ，ñ但ñ我ñ仍ñ然ñ相ñ信ñ我ñ獲ñ益ñ更ñ多ñ。ñ我ñ記ñ得ñ的ñ法ñ術ñ知ñ識ñ大ñ半ñ是ñ你ñ給ñ的ñ，�

	With jarring suddenness Owyn's mind was joined to Pug's, each dazed by the intimacy of the contact. ñThe ñartifact ñhas ñjarred ña ñmemory, Pug thought. ñI'm ñrecalling ñan ñincantation ñnow...ñI ñwill ñtry ñto ñretain ñthe ñthought...�
entries.translation:
@顫抖著舉起這只鑲滿珠寶的酒杯，感覺力量在這件寶飾器物中迸發湧動。他的意識如漣漪般不斷向外擴散，觸及了同行者的心靈，感受到敬畏、困惑、恐懼、痛苦，還有ó知識ð…
	猛然之間，歐文的心靈與帕格的心靈連結在一起，兩人都被這份親密的接觸震得暈頭轉向。ñ這ñ件ñ法ñ器ñ勾ñ起ñ了ñ記ñ憶ñ，ñ我ñ正ñ想ñ起ñ一ñ則ñ咒ñ語�

entries.source:
@ stirred and found that Gorath was standing over him, a look of concern on his face. "I had concern for your health," he said.
	"How long was...were ñwe out?" @ asked, sitting upright.
	"A ñlong time," Gorath replied, smiling at @'s startled reaction. "It is a good thing you both had presence enough of mind to drink the water I brought you."�
ñEliaemð. @ mouthed the name as he clasped the stone in his fist and concentrated, feeling the focal power of the magical artifact gather to respond to his need and will. A rusalki ñwould come...�
entries.translation: ñ伊萊安姆ð。@默唸著這個名字，同時把石頭緊握在拳心，凝神專注，感覺這件法器的聚焦力量正匯聚起來，回應他的需求與意志。一位露莎奇，ñ即將降臨…�

entries.source: Pressing the horn against his lips, @ blew hard, the whole of his body trembling as the exhalation blasted through the dragon's horn. In answer came a distant sound like the baying of wolves or of hounds, their calls ringing closer as they responded to their master's call...�
entries.translation: @把號角湊到唇邊，用力吹響，隨著這口氣猛然貫穿龍角，他全身都在顫抖。回應而來的，是遠方傳來像狼嚎又像犬吠的聲音，隨著牠們回應主人的召喚，叫聲逐漸逼近…�

entries.source: Though the eyelids of the ivory idol had been carved closed, they flickered open, revealing a pair of ratlike eyes. @ choked as a cold feminine voice began to speak through him. "ñI ñcall ñto ñmy ñhalls ñthe ñone ñchosen ñby ñthe ñone ñwho ñbears ñmy ñimage. ñChoose ñone ñto ñdie, ñ@...ð"�
entries.translation: 這尊象牙神像的眼瞼原本雕刻成闔起的模樣，此刻卻忽然睜開，露出一雙鼠眼。@被嗆住，一個冰冷的女聲開始透過他的口說話：「ñ我ñ召ñ喚ñ被ñ吾ñ聖ñ像ñ所ñ選ñ中ñ之ñ人ñ來ñ我ñ殿ñ堂ñ選ñ一ñ人ñ赴@ð」�

entries.source: A bloody rayed ball of energy rose from the pendant, hovering inches from the end of @'s nose as if awaiting a command. Unsure how he understood its intent, but nevertheless óunderstanding, @ concentrated his thoughts on the deadliest spells he could remember...�
entries.translation: 一顆血紅色、光芒四射的能量球從墜飾中升起，懸浮在@鼻尖前幾寸處，彷彿在等待指令。他不確定自己是怎麼理解到它的意圖的，但仍舊ó理解了，@把心思集中在他所能記得最致命的法術上…�

entries.source: Touching the manna to the crystalline staff, a faint glow suffused the length of the stave...�
entries.translation: 法力晶體一觸碰到水晶法杖，一道微光便沿著杖身瀰漫開來…�

entries.source: Using the ring as a focus for his powers, @ found that the words of a strange incantation were appearing in his mind, each setting his thoughts ablaze as he spoke them word for word. Frantic, he turned upon his enemy and sought to channel the hurtful energy elsewhere...�
entries.translation: @把戒指當作聚焦力量的媒介，發現一段陌生咒語的字句正浮現在腦海中，每唸出一個字，思緒便如火燒般熾熱。他倉皇轉身面向敵人，試圖將這股傷人的能量引導到別處…�

entries.source: A searing flash of heat vaporized the shell as @ touched it to the hilt of the glamredhel sword, elongating itself into a swirling length of blue flame. Around it, a shell of silver and steel congealed, forming first a blade and then a scabbard of unparalleled workmanship...�
entries.translation: @把貝殼碰上格拉姆瑞德劍的劍柄，一陣灼熱的閃光瞬間將貝殼氣化，拉長成一道盤旋的藍色火焰。火焰周圍，銀與鋼凝結成形，先化作劍身，再化作一柄工藝無雙的劍鞘…�

entries.source: Fearing that an infection might be loose in his system, @ attended to his various nicks and cuts with the contents of the herbal pack. While it wouldn't make his wounds go away, it would at least speed his healing...�
entries.translation: 深怕體內潛藏著感染，@用藥草包裡的東西處理身上大大小小的傷口。雖然沒法讓傷口立刻消失，但至少能加快癒合的速度…�

entries.source:
@ wiggled the small cask's cork loose and upended it, unmindful of the fact that it was spilling down his face and neck as he drank. Wiping the excess from his mouth with the back of his hand, he smiled unrepentantly.
	"Good stuff, that Keshian Ale."�
entries.translation:
@晃鬆了小酒桶的軟木塞，把桶倒過來就喝，渾然不顧酒水灑得滿臉滿頸都是。他用手背抹去嘴邊多餘的酒液，毫無悔意地笑了。
	「這凱許麥酒，真是好東西。」�

entries.source: @ plucked the strings of the practice lute carefully, aware his smallest mistakes were the cause of great grief to others. He could at least say he was learning, however minutely, every time he played the single tune he knew...�
entries.translation: @小心翼翼地撥弄練習用魯特琴的琴弦，深知自己再小的失誤，都會讓旁人苦不堪言。至少每次彈奏他唯一會的那首曲子時，他都能說自己有那麼一點點進步…�

entries.source:
@ cracked open the box's lid.
	Engulfed in a coruscating geyser of light which fountained from the interior of the small box, he shouted as he felt himself shot into the air like a crossbow bolt into the blue...�
entries.translation:
@撬開了盒蓋。
	一道自盒內噴湧而出、閃爍不定的光柱瞬間將他吞沒，他大叫一聲，感覺自己像弩箭般被射向空中，直衝雲霄…�

entries.source: As @ slid the tip of the magical artifact down the length of the sword, a glittering blue frost formed on the blade. Assuming his victim wasn't using some form of sarigsbane on his armor, the enchantment would make any wound done with the sword incredibly painful.�
entries.translation: @把這件法器的尖端沿著劍身滑過，一層閃爍的藍色冰霜隨即在劍刃上凝結。只要對手的盔甲上沒塗抹某種「薩瑞格的剋星」，這道附魔就能讓劍造成的傷口痛徹心扉。�

entries.source: A dark sheen appeared as @ applied the holy oilcloth, rubbing the metal until its surface drank up some of the residue. While its effects could be countered if his opponent had used the same oil, it at least ensured that he would be on even footing with anyone hostile that he met.�
entries.translation: @塗上這塊聖油布，金屬表面隨即浮現一層暗色光澤，他反覆搓揉，直到表面吸收了些許殘留油脂。雖然若對手也用了同樣的油，效果便會被抵銷，但至少能確保他在遇上敵意者時，不會落於下風。�

entries.source: Careful not to spill any of the poison onto his hands while doctoring the rations, @ nodded with satisfaction. "Unless someone takes a good look at these rations, they'll never know the difference."�
entries.translation: @小心翼翼地不讓毒藥沾到自己手上，一邊對這份口糧動了手腳，一邊滿意地點頭。「除非有人仔細檢查這些口糧，不然絕對看不出差別。」�

entries.source: As if some magic within the azure stone was awakened by @'s touch, a dark fluid began to spill through a crack in the artifact's mottled surface and down the length of his arm. Pouring it over his armor, he treated it carefully, its powers renowned for extinguishing swords set ablaze with magical flames.�
entries.translation: 彷彿@的觸碰喚醒了這塊天青石裡的某種魔力，一道黑色液體開始從器物斑駁的表面裂縫中滲出，沿著他的手臂流下。他把它澆在盔甲上，小心地處理著——這東西以能撲滅被法術之焰點燃的劍聞名。�

entries.source: Trying to conserve what little he had of the brown fluid, @ applied the flame root oil sparingly. Though it was rare that he had run across opponents who used naphtha to treat their blades, he wanted no unpleasant surprises if he did meet such individuals. Even in small amounts, the rare oil would extinguish any naphtha which contacted his armor.�
entries.translation: 為了節省手邊所剩無幾的棕色液體，@省著點塗上這種火根油。雖然他很少遇到用那夫沙油處理劍刃的對手，但真遇上這種人時，他可不想措手不及。哪怕只是少量，這種珍稀油脂也能撲滅任何接觸到他盔甲的那夫沙油火焰。�

entries.source: A dark sheen appeared as @ applied the holy oil, rubbing the metal until its surface drank up some of the residue. While its effects could be countered if his opponent had used the same oil, it at least ensured that he would be on even footing with anyone hostile that he met.�
entries.translation: @塗上這聖油，金屬表面隨即浮現一層暗色光澤，他反覆搓揉，直到表面吸收了些許殘留油脂。雖然若對手也用了同樣的油，效果便會被抵銷，但至少能確保他在遇上敵意者時，不會落於下風。�

entries.source: Uncorking the bottle, @ poured a small portion of the naphtha over the blade, then wiped most of the residue away. Once an enemy came within striking range, the first kiss of his blade against steel would spark quite a surprise for his intended target.�
entries.translation: @拔開瓶塞，把少量那夫沙油倒在劍刃上，再抹去大部分殘留的油脂。一旦敵人進入攻擊範圍，他的劍鋒第一次與鋼鐵相觸，就會給目標帶來一場不小的驚喜。�

entries.source: @ quickly dabbed large circles of the yellow ointment onto his armor, puzzled that his fingertips numbed as he applied it. Hopefully, it would work just as effectively against any magically enchanted blade that touched it.�
entries.translation: @快速地把黃色藥膏一圈圈塗在盔甲上，塗的時候指尖竟隱隱發麻，讓他有些納悶。希望這東西對付任何附魔劍刃的效果，都能一樣有效。�

entries.source: Flipping the ornate miniature over, @ slid his sword blade through the groove which had been incised into the spider's belly. While there was no fluid visible in the small channel, his blade now dripped a green venom.�
entries.translation: @把這件精緻的小雕像翻過來，將劍刃滑過刻在蜘蛛腹部的溝槽。雖然那道細小的溝槽裡看不見任何液體，但他的劍刃此刻已滴著綠色的毒液。�

entries.source: A look of absolute concentration was etched on @'s face as he prepared his blade with the Silverthorn. Pinching off a single berry, he crushed it against the blade, causing a bloodlike fluid to trickle down the length of the sword's fuller. He would have to take great care not to scratch himself on it when he resheathed the weapon or the venom would have him dead within minutes.�
entries.translation: @臉上刻滿了全神貫注的神情，正用「銀刺」處理他的劍刃。他掐下一顆漿果，壓碎在劍身上，一道血色般的液體隨即順著劍槽淌下。他得萬分小心，收劍入鞘時千萬別劃傷自己，否則這毒液會在幾分鐘內要他的命。�

entries.source: Cautious not to cut himself on the shards of glass, @ broke a bulb of the anti-venom over the surface of his armor. Even a thin coating of the substance would be enough to neutralize a blade envenomed with the deadly Silverthorn poison.�
entries.translation: @小心不讓自己被玻璃碎片割傷，把一顆解毒劑小球捏碎，塗在盔甲表面。哪怕只是薄薄一層，也足以中和沾染致命「銀刺」毒液的劍刃。�

entries.source: Half-expecting it to have some unnatural taste, @ gulped down the blessed liquid, but found it had no flavor at all that he could detect. If not for the strange sensation that was welling up within him, he would have suspected the vial simply contained well water or something equally innocuous.�
entries.translation: @原本半猜想這東西會有種不自然的味道，一口吞下這瓶受祝聖的液體，卻發現自己嚐不出任何味道。要不是體內湧起一股奇異的感覺，他還真會懷疑這小瓶裡裝的不過是井水，或是同樣無害的什麼東西。�

entries.source: @ took a sparing swig from the vial of Fadamor's Formula, cringing as faint rushes of heat washed through his muscles. Suddenly, he felt wildly exhilarated.�
entries.translation: @小心地啜了一口「法達莫爾秘方」，一陣陣微熱竄過肌肉，讓他忍不住皺眉。突然間，他感到一陣狂喜湧上心頭。�

entries.source: Thick and tantalizingly sweet, @ sucked down a dram of the sorcerer's potion, then recorked the vial with the heel of his hand. Slowly his awareness of the world dimmed, shoved aside as something within him began to reorganize his thoughts. Soon there would be no thought in him but his óspellcasting...�
entries.translation: 這種法師藥水濃稠又誘人地甘甜，@啜了一小口，隨即用掌根把瓶塞壓回去。他對周遭世界的感知漸漸模糊，被體內某種正在重新整理他思緒的東西所取代。很快地，他心裡便再無其他念頭，只剩下ó施法…�

entries.source: Closing his eyes, @ quaffed down some of the bitter tasting fluid. "Dreadful," he croaked. "Next time I'll just drink from a sewer."�
entries.translation: @閉上眼睛，灌下幾口這帶著苦味的液體。「難喝死了，」他啞著嗓子說。「下次我乾脆去下水道喝算了。」�

entries.source: The tea tasted familiar, reminding him vaguely of a minty concoction brewed in taverns to cut the chill during winter months. More interesting was the fact that the world around him seemed to gain óclarity, as if he could see things he hadn't noticed before he drank the mixture.�
entries.translation: 這種茶的味道有些熟悉，隱約讓他想起酒館裡冬天用來驅寒的薄荷茶飲。更有趣的是，周遭世界似乎變得ó更加清晰，彷彿喝下這帖藥後，能看見喝之前沒注意到的東西。�

entries.source: Little caring how the liquid might taste, @ took a swill from the vial and swallowed greedily, the strange liquid having an immediate warming effect in his hands and feet. Almost as quickly, his many aches and pains began to subside.�
entries.translation: @根本不在乎這液體是什麼味道，從小瓶裡灌了一大口，貪婪地吞下肚。這種奇異的液體立刻讓他的手腳感到一陣暖意。幾乎同時，他身上大大小小的痠痛也開始消退。�

A translation of an ancient account of the travels of an abbot from Malac's Cross, the book was filled with stories and notes on mythology. Apparently the abbot had been looking for proof of the existence of a sword known as the Guarda Revanche, a cursed blade which was often associated with the moredhel. Shortly before the end of the journal, he related a curious tale:
	
	ñ"...and ñso ñcame ñI ñunto ñthe ñAbbey ñof ñKillian ñwhich ñstood ñunto ñthe ñwestern ñfringe ñof ñthe ñforest ñof ñthe ñEledhel, ñso ñnamed ñElvandar, ñand ñthere ñwas ñshown ña ñfairy ñchest ñupon ñwhose ñface ñwere ñthe ñrunes ñwhich ñare ñcommon ñunto ñthe ñelven ñand ñmoredhel ñkin. ñA ñcertain ñfather ñthen ñdid ñturn ñthe ñstrange ñcylinders ñwhich ñwere ñon ñthe face ñof ñthe ñchest, ñforming ña ñword ñunfamiliar ñto ñme, ñGLAMREDHEL, ñbut ñone ñwhich ñthrew ñopen ñthe ñlatches ñwhich ñbound ñclosed ñthe ñlid ñof ñthe ñbox. ñFrom ñwithin ñhe ñbrought ña ñfinely ñjeweled ñhilt ñwhich ñhe ñcalled ñthe ñGaeda. ñThis ñfather ñthen ñtold ñme ñit ñhad ñcome ñfrom ña ñruin ñof ñan ñancient ñplace ñand ñsince, ñthere ñwas ñmuch ñmisfortune ñcome ñunto ñtheir ñabbey ñand ñthey ñwilled ñit ñshould ñbe ñreturned ñthere ñfor ñits ñeternal ñrest. ñHe ñalso ñdid ñtell ñme ñother ñthings ñstrange ñand ñwondrous ñof ñthe ñlegend, ñsaying ña ñspell ñhad ñbeen ñbound ñinto ña ñshell ñthat ñwould ñrepair ñthe ñblade ñwhich ñhad ñlong ñbeen ñbroke ñaway, ñdescribing ñthis ñshell ñas ñone ñmarked ñwith ñan ñuneven ñsurface ñof ñten ñmisformed ñlumps..."�

entries.source: A journal of an unknown dwarf, the majority of the pages in the book were concerned with a creature which the author referred alternately as a Braek Nuir, Braak Noor, and Brak Nurr. Some mention was also made about a secret chamber in the lower chambers of the Mac Mordain Cadal which once had been occupied by someone named Rhuargh.�
entries.translation: 這是一本無名矮人的日記，書中大部分篇幅都在講述一種生物，作者交替稱之為「布雷克努爾」、「布拉克諾爾」與「布拉克努爾」。書中也提及麥克莫丹卡達爾地底深處一間密室，曾有個叫魯阿格的人住過。�

entries.source: Primarily the book was about óbattle, the majority of the text concerning itself with various famous skirmishes which had been fought between the members of the Kingdom garrison at Shamata and the famed dog soldiers of the Great Empire of Kesh. Perhaps more valuable was the wealth of information which had been gathered on different fighting techniques, each highly detailed with illuminated diagrams on stances, swings and other issues concerning themselves with the act of fighting. Also included in the book were a number of smaller anecdotes about standard life at the garrison, the amount of food consumed in one month by the soldiers, the cost of weapons imported from the empire and the difficulties in purchasing goods when political swings were taking place. One story which particularly took @'s interest was a mention that a potion called Redweed Brew was a major import of the garrison and that they claimed it temporarily enhanced how well the soldiers fought in battle.�
entries.translation: 這本書主要談的是ó戰鬥，大部分內容都在描述王國沙瑪塔守軍與大凱許帝國著名「猛犬軍團」之間的多場知名小規模衝突。或許更有價值的，是書中蒐集的各種戰鬥技巧資料，每一項都配有精細插圖，詳解站姿、揮擊等各種戰鬥要點。書裡還收錄了一些駐軍日常生活的小軼事：士兵一個月消耗多少糧食、從帝國進口武器的成本、政局動盪時採購物資的困難。其中特別引起@興趣的一則故事提到，一種叫「紅草釀」的藥水是駐軍的主要進口物資，據說能暫時提升士兵的戰鬥表現。�

entries.source: Though it seemed clear to @ that Dorcas' knew intimately the material about which he was writing, he unfortunately assumed that his readers also understood many principles which were obscure or unheard of by most magicians. In the author's favor, he did make many useful points on the subject of óinterrelation, the principle allowed a magician to strike a target object with a spell, and suggested that people first practicing the craft use a concoction called Lewton's Concentrate to improve the accuracy with which they directed their spells.�
entries.translation: @看得出來，多爾卡斯對自己所寫的題材顯然瞭若指掌，可惜他不巧假設讀者也理解許多多數法師都陌生或聞所未聞的原理。這位作者值得肯定的是，他確實對ó「連結」這個主題提出了不少有用的見解——這項原理讓法師能以法術擊中目標物，並建議初學者使用一種叫「路頓濃縮液」的藥劑，來提升施法的準確度。�

entries.source: Concise and poetical after a fashion, Kalem's book detailed many of the factors that could affect an quarrel while in flight and the measures that could be taken to compensate for crosswinds, bolts with poor spines, and targets that were partially obscured. He further went on to recommend that archers consume Truesight Tea regularly as a means to sharpen their sight and advised the reader to keep bowstrings and Aventurine handy to maintain crossbows.�
entries.translation: 卡倫的這本書簡潔中帶著幾分詩意，詳細列舉了影響箭矢飛行的各種因素，以及應對側風、劣質箭桿、部分遮蔽目標的辦法。他還進一步建議弓箭手定期飲用真視茶來增強視力，並提醒讀者隨身備妥弓弦與砂金石，以便保養弩。�

entries.source: Essentially a book of prayers, most of the psalms dealt with the mythology surrounding the defender goddess and her frequent clashes with the war god, Tith Onanka. It advised which prayers should be said upon waking, which should be used before sleeping, before eating, before entering inns, and most importantly, which should be mouthed before entering battle so that the defender goddess would add her favor to the faithful's ability to defend him or herself. It also mentioned in passing that the goddess would also lend her favor to those that drank the Dalatail Milk sometimes sold by her followers.�
entries.translation: 這本質上是一本禱文集，多數詩篇都圍繞著守護女神的神話，以及她與戰神提斯歐南卡的多次交鋒展開。書中詳述了醒來時該唸哪段禱文、睡前、用餐前、進入客棧前又該唸哪段，最重要的是，臨戰前該默唸哪段禱文，好讓守護女神眷顧信徒的自保之力。書中也順帶提及，飲用信徒偶爾兜售的「達拉泰爾聖水」，同樣能獲得女神的眷顧。�

entries.source: Many times, @ flipped back to the cover of the book to reaffirm that the title had in ñsome way been connected to the migration of birds. While the author had ñbegun a discussion on winged wildlife, he had quickly meandered into a discussion of the famed battles of Midkemia, continued on to a reiteration of various battle songs, diverted to a rant about the prices of ale in the Kingdom's taverns, tangentially lamented about the plight of magicians and then ended on a humorous anecdote about his mother-in-law having consumed a vial of Fadamor's Formula to outslug a Tsurani warrior in a bar brawl.�
entries.translation: @好幾次翻回封面，想再次確認書名跟候鳥遷徙ñ多少有點關聯。雖然作者ñ確實從飛禽野生動物談起，卻很快就扯到米德凱米亞的知名戰役，接著又反覆吟誦起各種戰歌，接著離題抱怨起王國酒館的酒價，又岔題感嘆法師的處境艱難，最後以一則趣聞收尾——他岳母在酒館鬥毆中灌下一瓶「法達莫爾秘方」，撂倒了一名圖蘭尼武士。�

entries.source: Although he could have wished for better circumstances under which to study it, @ broke the scroll's wax seal and began to read. After an hour's laboring with the difficult language he was able to commit the incantation to memory. While the words on the parchment etched indelible patterns in his mind, the scroll grew brittle, then crumbled slowly between his fingers like sun-dried leaves.�
entries.translation: 雖然他希望能有更好的環境來研讀，@還是拆開了卷軸的蠟封，開始閱讀。花了一個鐘頭跟艱澀的文字奮戰後，他總算把咒語牢記在心。羊皮紙上的字句在他腦海中刻下了不可磨滅的印記，而卷軸本身卻逐漸變脆，在他指間如曬乾的落葉般緩緩碎裂。�
